title: Nativity!
about: A primary school teacher accidentally promises that Hollywood is coming to see his school's nativity play.
cue: Serve the sweets when the nativity play starts.

    StartersChristmas fair pork and apple rollsPork, apple and sage sausage rolls in puff pastryHow to make it500g pork sausage mince1 apple, grated1 onion, grated2 tbsp chopped sage30g breadcrumbs2 sheets of puff pastry1 egg, beaten1 tbsp sesame seeds200g tomato relishMix the sausage mince with the apple, onion, sage and breadcrumbs.Cut the pastry in half, lay a log of filling along each strip, roll up and seal underneath.Brush with egg, sprinkle with sesame seeds and cut into pieces.Bake at 200°C until golden. Serve with relish.Coventry cheese and onion pastiesShortcrust pasties of cheddar, potato and onion, from the school Christmas fairHow to make it3 sheets of frozen shortcrust pastry, thawed300g potatoes, finely diced1 onion, finely diced200g vintage cheddar, grated1 tsp English mustard1 egg, beatenHeat the oven to 200°C. Boil the potatoes 6 minutes until just tender and drain.Mix the potatoes, onion, cheddar, mustard, salt and pepper.Cut 12cm rounds from the pastry, fill one side, fold over and crimp the edges.Brush with egg and bake 25 minutes until golden.MainsCoventry Christmas roast chicken dinnerRoast chicken, pigs in blankets, roast potatoes, maple sprouts, gravyHow to make it1.8kg whole chicken30g butter12 chipolatas12 rashers of streaky bacon (8 to wrap, 4 to fry)1kg potatoes, parboiled3 tbsp vegetable oil400g Brussels sprouts, halved1 tbsp maple syrup1 tbsp plain flour350ml chicken stockRub the chicken with butter and salt.Roast at 200°C.Wrap the chipolatas in half rashers of bacon and add for the last part of the roasting.Roast the parboiled potatoes in oil.Fry the sprouts with diced bacon, then toss with maple syrup.Make gravy from the pan juices with the flour and stock.Oakmoor School's posh salmon en croûteMr Shakespeare's posh rival school does a very fancy nativityHow to make it700g skinless salmon fillet150g cream cheese1 bunch dill1 lemon120g baby spinach2 sheets of frozen puff pastry1 egg800g new potatoes300g green beans30g butterHeat the oven to 200°C. Wilt the spinach and squeeze dry. Mix the cream cheese with chopped dill and lemon zest.Lay the salmon on the pastry, spread with the cream cheese and spinach, wrap and brush with egg.Bake until golden. Boil the potatoes at the same time.Boil the beans and toss the beans and potatoes with butter. Slice the salmon to serve.SweetsMr Poppy's Christmas pudding sundaesChristmas pudding, vanilla ice cream, custard, toffee sauce and honeycombHow to make it800g Christmas pudding300ml thick vanilla custard1 L vanilla ice cream1 bottle toffee sauce150ml thickened cream, whipped40g crushed honeycombWarm the pudding in the microwave or steamer as the packet says, then break half of it into chunks.Warm the custard.In sundae glasses layer pudding chunks, a scoop of ice cream, custard and a drizzle of toffee sauce, then repeat.Finish with whipped cream and crushed honeycomb.St Bernadette's staffroom mince piesShortcrust fruit mince pies with star topsHow to make it3 sheets of shortcrust pastry1 jar fruit mince (400g)1 egg, beaten200ml thickened cream2 tbsp icing sugar1 orange, zestedCut rounds from two pastry sheets and press into a greased patty pan tin.Fill each with fruit mince. Cut stars from the third sheet and lay on top.Brush with egg and bake at 190°C until golden.Whip the cream with some of the icing sugar and the orange zest.Dust the warm pies with icing sugar and serve with the cream.DrinksNativity night hot blackcurrant punchHot apple juice and blackcurrant cordial with cinnamon, clove and gingerHow to make it1 L cloudy apple juice400ml water150ml blackcurrant cordial2 cinnamon sticks4 cloves1 knob ginger, sliced1 orange, slicedPour the apple juice and water into a saucepan with the cordial, cinnamon, cloves, ginger and orange.Heat gently without boiling.Strain into mugs and add an orange slice to each.
